questions.evidence:
[Visit rules] Old Street has six audio stops. Visitors may choose any stops. Printed transcripts tell the same stories. Borrowed players must return to the desk by 4:45; downloaded recordings on personal phones have no equipment return deadline.

[Time estimates] From the desk, a visit to Stops 1 and 2 and back takes twenty minutes, including both recordings. Stops 3 and 4 and back take thirty minutes. All six stops and the return take forty minutes. These are complete route times, not times for each stop.

[Visitors] Aki arrives at 4:15 and borrows a player. She wants a ten-minute margin before returning it. Ben arrives at 4:20 with downloaded recordings on his own phone and wants all six stops. Cara wants to read the stories without listening.

The helper suggests Stops 1 and 2 for Aki. Ben can finish his full walk at about five, and Cara can collect a transcript before the desk closes at five. Each visitor gets a useful experience by matching the plan to a different condition.
